desc.zh: Lockwood 001 在主锁舌旁边有一枚小三角副舌（Pin）。关门后如果门缝过大（>5mm），副舌掉进扣板槽而未被扣板边缘压平，主舌实际上并没有死锁，用卡片即可顶开！
desc.en: Critical deadlatch flaw: If auxiliary pin enters strike cavity instead of being depressed by strike rim, lock remains vulnerable.

keyMetrics: 门缝隙必须 ≤3.5mm · 副舌压入行程 ≥5mm · 扣板垫片调校

title.zh: 澳式经典木门 32mm 圆孔锁芯贯穿与加长连杆销 (Tail Extension)
title.en: Lockwood 001 Rim Cylinder 32mm Hole Through-Bore & Tail Extension

desc.zh: 安装外装锁时门扇只需钻一个 32mm 通孔供外锁芯穿过。对于厚度超过 45mm 的厚重实木大门，必须加装 Lockwood 原厂加长传动十字尾条。
desc.en: Single 32mm cross bore for external cylinder. Doors thicker than 45mm require lengthened drive connecting bar.

title.zh: 英国传统木门 Union 3 拨杆插芯锁（3-Lever Sashlock）面板更新
title.en: UK Union 3-Lever Interior Sashlock Case Replacement & Prep

lockFamilyName: 英标5拨杆防盗插芯死锁

desc.zh: 英国大量老维多利亚风格联排别墅次入户门使用 3 拨杆锁。钥匙孔与外框非常古老，加装改造需采用特制扁平适配片将拨杆锁槽转换为方轴驱动。
desc.en: Victorian UK 3-lever sashlock. Historic door requires brass conversion escutcheon for modern drive fitting.

keyMetrics: 背距 44mm/57mm · 中心距 57mm · 拨杆数 3 Levers

title.zh: 新加坡 HDB 铁闸门内侧加装防误触手伸格栅亚克力挡板
title.en: Singapore HDB Security Gate Anti-Bypass Acrylic Guard Shield

desc.en: Wide gate ironwork permits reaching through. Retrofit gate locks must include polycarbonate safety shield.

keyMetrics: 挡板厚度 4.0mm · 防护半径 ≥150mm · 防爆阻燃材质

sceneType: 日本老旧团地住宅标配

desc.zh: 日本 1970-1990 年代公团住宅（UR 团地）普及度最高的 PMK 锁体。锁盒全部凸出门表面，SwitchBot 等加装锁需使用专用悬臂支架跨过锁盒。

title.en: Japan GOAL TX Cylinder Mortise Weatherstrip Pressure Test

desc.en: Acoustic door gaskets in modern Japanese mansions create latch drag. Motor firmware requires staged torque boost.

title.en: Brazil Stam 40mm Narrow Mortise Zinc Spindle Runout Test

desc.zh: 巴西大众住宅广泛使用的低成本锌合金锁体。方轴孔与锁芯孔中心距公差有时达到 ±1.5mm，加装转接套筒必须具备柔性万向节以防硬性咬死。
desc.en: Budget zinc mortise locks in Brazil have wide center-to-center tolerances. Couplers require flexible joint.
